mode: offline retrieval and proposed-evidence adapter comparison

configuration.selection: unmodified BRE-182 retriever for both systems
configuration.revision_schedule: identical static freeze; synthetic lifecycle replay is a separate demo

isolation.mechanism: Node --permission exact source/retriever read allowlist; no child-process, FFI, or write grants
isolation.boundary: Fixture process file-access check, not hostile-code OS isolation or production authorization

answers.reason: Neither system generates or semantically adjudicates answers. Known abstentions are failures to answer. Unknown labels plus citations are a safety check, not adjudicated correct-unknown recall.
